verdict.rationale: Gusto's business compliance page lists registered agent service. It states that when Gusto is your registered agent, your filing address stays private and your mail is monitored and routed to you through Gusto; the service is included on Premium or costs $85/month per state as an add-on. Government mail monitoring inside Gusto is also documented and independently mentioned by CPA Practice Advisor. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that mail is scanned and delivered digitally, explicit handling of service of process, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the registered agent service itself.
